intent: Initial geometry proposal with a balanced sensor array centered around the axle and extending forward to cover the line width. The body size and mass are moderate to balance stability and agility. Sensors are spaced symmetrically to detect line position and edges effectively. Expecting good line detection and stable control for the integrator to build a controller on.
rationale: Starting with a moderate-sized robot body (0.18m length, 0.14m width) and mass (1.0kg) to balance stability and maneuverability. Wheel radius and track are set to mid-range values for good traction and turning. The sensor array has 5 sensors spaced laterally from -0.04m to 0.04m and positioned forward from the axle to cover the tape line width (25mm) plus some margin, with a sensor size of 12mm square for a good balance between resolution and coverage. This layout should provide the integrator with sufficient line position information to develop an effective controller. Measurement requests include completion, progress, rms_error, line_loss_events, and completion_time to evaluate performance and guide future geometry adjustments.
